seoTitle: Frequency Converter: Hz, kHz, MHz, GHz and RPM
metaDescription: Convert hertz, kilohertz, megahertz, gigahertz, RPM and rad/s, and see the period. Free and offline.
intro: Converts frequency and rotational speed between hertz, kHz, MHz, GHz, revolutions per minute and radians per second, and shows the period of one cycle.
why:
Motors are rated in RPM, signals in Hz and clocks in MHz or GHz. 1 Hz is 60 RPM, which is easy to forget.

The tool also shows the period of one cycle so you can move between frequency and time.
howTo: Read the other units and the period.

faq.a: Angular speed. One turn per second is 2 pi, about 6.283 rad/s.

faq.q: Does it give motor shaft speed from mains frequency?
faq.a: No. Pole count and slip change the real speed.
